messages.text: Where is my order? Order #Shop····, email (email hidden)
Handed to the team · No current ship date on the order; Oct 30 date has passed.

Benjamin, I'm sorry. Your B30 hasn't shipped yet, and that's now past the October 30 date we gave you.

Your Power Kit is set aside at our Chattanooga warehouse. The B30 is waiting for the batch 1 US units to arrive there. We emailed you on November 3 with photos from the factory. Once the units are checked in, yours ships and tracking goes to your email.

I don't have a firm ship day yet, so I've asked the team to confirm one. Please stay in the chat. If you step away, the answer will come to your email. You can follow the batch here: https://heliumdeploy.com/pages/shipment-status

I checked again just now and nothing has changed. Your B30 is still waiting on the batch 1 stock at Chattanooga, and your Power Kit is set aside for you there.

The team has your request for a firm ship date. Someone will reply here. If you leave the chat, the answer will come to your email.

While you wait, is there anything else about the order I can look into?
